newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RONALDO TOP OF THE CLASS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO TOP OF THE CLASS.

text.p: Brazilian marksman Ronaldo was awarded 9.17 marks out of 10 for his performance so far in a poll of Barcelona fans published by Monday's El Mundo Deportivo sports daily.
More than 70 percent believe he will prove to be a better player than Diego Maradona.
English coach Bobby Robson received only 3.89 for strategy but 8.75 for charisma.
Only two percent said Barcelona should sign another coach and nearly 75 percent reckoned the club would win the Spanish championship.
